name: Mensch ärgere dich nicht
blurb: Four colours, four pieces each, one dice on the table. Roll it, walk to a piece, and send it round. First colour home wins.

do.event: R rolls your die · E picks up and puts down · F ends your turn
blue has all four home - blue wins
green has all four home - green wins
red has all four home - red wins
yellow has all four home - yellow wins

roll.says: Press R to throw your die, from wherever you are standing.

move.says: E takes a piece and E puts it down — or hold E to carry it. Then F ends your turn.

over-blue.says: Blue has all four pieces home. Blue wins.

over-green.says: Green has all four pieces home. Green wins.

over-red.says: Red has all four pieces home. Red wins.

over-yellow.says: Yellow has all four pieces home. Yellow wins.
